newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare Financial sets commercial paper.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Financial sets commercial paper.

text.p: HealthCare Financial Partners Inc said Monday it has secured $100 million of financing from ING Barings U.S. Capital Markets under an investment grade, asset-backed commercial paper program.
Under the terms of the ING program, effective immediately, HealthCare Financial will be able to borrow up to $100 million against assets that meet certain criteria.

"HealthCare Financial Partners now has more than $150 million in capital and our ability to grow and finance future operations is greatly enhanced by this additional financing," the company said in a statement.
"Together with the proceeds of our IPO on November 21 and our bank line of credit, the company is well positioned to meet its financing needs for its accounts receivable finance program.
"In addition, the ING program lowers the company's overall cost of funds and allows the company to be significantly more competitive in its pursuit of new business," it said.
